name: depdetangler
description: Dependency Detangler for Python: opinionated, configurable formatting for pip requirements and selected imports.

enumDescriptions: Merge extras from duplicate package entries into one requirement.
Keep distinct extra selections on separate lines while sharing the resolved version.
Enforce one extra per requirement line and group packages only when they contain more than one distinct extra.
depDetangler.requirements.extraMode.description: How duplicate package extras are emitted.

depDetangler.requirements.normalizeExtra.description: Normalize non-authoritative extra names to lowercase with hyphens.

enumDescriptions: Do not use installed/PyPI metadata to restore names.
Restore both package names and extra names.
depDetangler.requirements.pypiNameLookup.description: Which names to restore from installed metadata, with PyPI as fallback.

depDetangler.requirements.preferInstalle.description: Check local Python distribution metadata before querying PyPI.

depDetangler.requirements.cacheTtlDays.description: PyPI metadata cache lifetime in days. Stale data remains a fallback when PyPI is unavailable.

depDetangler.python.collapseMultilineImp.description: Collapse recognized multiline from-imports to one line.

depDetangler.python.expandMultiImports.description: Always split comma-separated plain imports into individual statements.

depDetangler.python.alwaysSeparateSingle.description: Split a standalone comma-separated plain import even when Expand Multi Imports is disabled.

depDetangler.python.separateFromImports.description: Place from-imports above plain imports with one blank line between the groups.
